blocks.text: 25 questions: five from each of the 5 chapters, in a random order.

Your first answer to each question is the one that counts. 90% or better passes, and passing earns the badge for Verbal Aspect. You can take it as often as you like; the questions are dealt afresh each time.

topics.title: Two aspects: the process and the result

exercises.q: Я думаю, она ___ (осознавать), что на неё заглядываются многие парни.
exercises.prompt: I think she was conscious of being stared at by many boys.
Looks like the transmission belt broke.
The world is not going to be saved by legislation.
Did you think Marseilles was the capital city of France?

exercises.q: Ни у кого не ___ (возникать) никаких вопросов касательно плана.
exercises.prompt: No one had any questions about the plan.
Tom waited a moment before replying.
Computers will save you a lot of time.

exercises.q: Несомненное достоинство автоматических дверей в том, что люди больше не ___ (разносить) заразу через дверные ручки.
exercises.prompt: A definite advantage of automatic doors is that people can't spread their contagious diseases by touching door handles.
When and where was Beethoven born?

topics.title: Words that call for the imperfective

exercises.prompt: He used to meditate in the morning.
People don't always behave rationally.

exercises.q: Я весь день ___ (сидеть) перед монитором и потому попадаю под сильное электромагнитное излучение.
exercises.prompt: I sit in front of a computer screen all day, so I get pretty heavily bombarded by electro-magnetic waves.

exercises.q: Каждое предложение на Татоэбе уникально, потому что все повторы ___ (удаляться).
exercises.prompt: Every Tatoeba sentence is unique, because any duplicates get deleted.
The teacher pokes his nose into everything.

exercises.q: Я ___ (оббегать) весь город в попытках занять немного денег.
exercises.prompt: I ran all over town trying to borrow some money.

exercises.q: ___ (задуть) все свечи на своём именинном пироге одним махом.
exercises.prompt: Blow out all the candles on the birthday cake at once.
Never lose confidence.
Don't go beyond the speed limit.

exercises.q: ___ (дать) молоку постоять ночь, а потом снимите с него сливки.
exercises.prompt: Let the milk stand overnight and skim off the cream.
Don't ever talk to me again.

exercises.q: ___ (сложить) этот листок пополам вертикально, потом горизонтально.
exercises.prompt: Fold this sheet in half vertically and horizontally.
Don't bother to call me.
Don't bother me with details.
Don't play with the mud. You're getting dirty.
One crow doesn't peck another's eye.
The couch won't fit in the elevator.
Read out the entire list, please.
That'll make her very happy.
I will sleep at ten o'clock.
So are you translating or twiddling your fingers?
Crude oil is refined at this plant.

exercises.q: Я всегда с трудом ___ (доносить) свои мысли.
exercises.prompt: I always have difficulty in making myself understood.
How are we going to get the piano upstairs?
The ice is going to break under your weight.

exercises.q: Я ___ (посадить) у себя в саду акацию.
exercises.prompt: I'm going to plant an acacia tree in my garden.
Can you clean the mess up?
Let's synchronize our watches.
All right, I will do it again.

exercises.q: Я надеялся, что пунш ___ (разрешить) язык моего старого знакомца.
exercises.prompt: I hoped that some punch would loosen the tongue of my old friend.
Am I going to bleed to death?
You just don't get it.
We'll do without it.

exercises.q: Изучение клингона сильно ___ (помочь) его карьере бизнесмена.
exercises.prompt: Learning Klingon will be of great use for his career as a businessman.

exercises.q: Мы ___ (выиграть) время, если пойдём напрямик через поле.
exercises.prompt: It'll save time if we cut across the field.
Let's put all the cards on the table.
Can you tell me the time?
Tom drives me nuts.

exercises.q: Много средств ___ (уйти) на обустройство новой квартиры.
exercises.prompt: It costs a lot to furnish a new apartment.
My phone is about to die.
Let's keep an eye on Tom.
Meet me at the hotel bar.

exercises.q: Несоблюдение этих предписаний ___ (повлечь) за собой штрафные санкции.
exercises.prompt: Failure to observe these regulations will result in penalties.

exercises.q: Я думал, что ___ (задохнуться) в переполненном поезде.
exercises.prompt: I thought I was going to suffocate on the crowded train.
Maybe I'll shave my head.

topics.title: по- and с- with ходить, ездить, летать

exercises.prompt: There is no one standard for beauty.
Test pilots are constantly tempting fate.
After a short pursuit, the police caught him.

exercises.q: Том на улице играет со ___ (свой) собакой в фрисби.
exercises.prompt: Tom is outside playing frisbee with his dog.

exercises.q: Мы до сих ___ (пора) многого не знаем о неандертальцах.
exercises.prompt: There are still many things we don't know about the Neanderthals.
